<!--
Think–Pair–Share timer (revealjs only).

Usage: put the question on a slide, then add the Quarto include shortcode for
_extensions/paytonej/ucinci/resources/partials/think-pair-share.qmd on the line below the question (written out here
in words, because a shortcode inside this comment would still be expanded).

Clicks (advances) on the slide:
  1. THINK starts: 1:15 countdown.  When it ends, PAIR starts automatically (1:45).
     When PAIR ends, the panel switches to SHARE.
  2–4. Each click draws one random name from the roster (Roster.xlsx, or the
       file named by roster_file in an earlier code cell; sample names otherwise).
Clicking a draw step early ends the timers and jumps to SHARE.
Click the clock to pause or resume. Stepping backward undoes the last step.
Names are not repeated within one lecture until everyone has been called.
Several copies can be used in one deck.
Needs the Jupyter engine with pandas (and openpyxl for .xlsx).
-->

::: {.content-visible when-format="revealjs"}

```{python}
#| output: asis
import json
import pandas as pd

# Roster: a spreadsheet or CSV with a "First Name" column. Set roster_file in an
# earlier code cell to use another file; without one, sample names are drawn.
try:
    _rf = globals().get("roster_file", "Roster.xlsx")
    _df = pd.read_csv(_rf) if str(_rf).lower().endswith(".csv") else pd.read_excel(_rf)
    _first = _df["First Name"].astype(str).str.strip()
    _last = _df["Last Name"].astype(str).str.strip() if "Last Name" in _df else pd.Series([""] * len(_df))
    _ok = _first.ne("") & _first.ne("nan")
    _first, _last = _first[_ok], _last[_ok]
    _dup = _first.duplicated(keep=False)   # disambiguate shared first names with a last initial
    _tps_names = [f"{f} {l[0]}." if d and l and l != "nan" else f
                  for f, l, d in zip(_first, _last, _dup)]
except Exception:
    _tps_names = ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "Diana", "Eve", "Frank"]

print(f"<script>window.TPS_ROSTER = {json.dumps(_tps_names)};</script>")
```

```{=html}
<style>
.tps {
  --tps-think: #d1b179;   /* Gettler gold  */
  --tps-pair:  #e00122;   /* UC red        */
  --tps-share: #a7a5aa;   /* Steger silver */
  --tps-bg:    #333333;   /* Bearcats black */
  --tps-accent: var(--tps-think);
  margin: .4em 0 0;
  padding: .45em .8em;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--tps-bg);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: .62em;
  line-height: 1.25;
  border-left: 10px solid var(--tps-accent);
  transition: border-color .4s;
}
.tps[data-phase="pair"]  { --tps-accent: var(--tps-pair); }
.tps[data-phase="share"] { --tps-accent: var(--tps-share); }

.tps-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1em; }
.tps-steps { display: flex; gap: .35em; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; }
.tps-steps span { padding: .1em .55em; border-radius: 6px; color: #a7a5aa; }
.tps[data-phase="think"] .tps-steps .s-think,
.tps[data-phase="pair"]  .tps-steps .s-pair,
.tps[data-phase="share"] .tps-steps .s-share { background: var(--tps-accent); color: #000; }
.tps[data-phase="pair"]  .tps-steps .s-pair  { color: #fff; }
.tps-hint { color: #a7a5aa; font-style: italic; margin-left: auto; }
.tps:not([data-phase="idle"]) .tps-hint { display: none; }

.tps-clock {
  margin-left: auto;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  font-size: 2.1em; font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer; user-select: none;
}
.tps[data-phase="idle"] .tps-clock,
.tps[data-phase="share"] .tps-clock { display: none; }
.tps-clock.paused { opacity: .45; }
.tps-clock.paused::after { content: " ❚❚"; font-size: .45em; vertical-align: middle; }
.tps-clock.urgent { color: var(--tps-pair); animation: tps-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite; }
.tps[data-phase="pair"] .tps-clock.urgent { color: #fff; }
@keyframes tps-pulse { 50% { transform: scale(1.08); } }

.tps-bar { height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.15); margin: .35em 0 .1em; overflow: hidden; }
.tps-bar > div { height: 100%; width: 100%; background: var(--tps-accent); transform-origin: left; }
.tps[data-phase="idle"] .tps-bar, .tps[data-phase="share"] .tps-bar { display: none; }

.tps-body { display: none; margin-top: .3em; }
.tps[data-phase="think"] .b-think,
.tps[data-phase="pair"]  .b-pair,
.tps[data-phase="share"] .b-share { display: block; }
.tps-lead { font-size: 1.15em; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 .3em; }
.tps-cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: .5em; }
.tps-cards div {
  border: 2px solid var(--tps-think); border-radius: 8px;
  padding: .3em .5em; text-align: center;
}
.tps-cards b { display: block; color: var(--tps-think); font-size: 1.1em; }
.tps-cards small { color: #e0dfe3; }

.tps-names { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: .5em; }
.tps-name {
  border: 2px dashed #a7a5aa; border-radius: 8px;
  padding: .35em .5em; text-align: center; font-size: 1.3em; font-weight: 700;
  min-height: 1.4em; color: #a7a5aa;
}
.tps-name.rolling { border-style: solid; color: #e0dfe3; }
.tps-name.landed  { border: 2px solid #fff; color: #fff; background: rgba(224,1,34,.55);
                    animation: tps-pop .45s cubic-bezier(.175,.885,.32,1.275); }
@keyframes tps-pop { 0% { transform: scale(.6); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }

.tps-trigger { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
</style>

<div class="tps" data-phase="idle" data-think="75" data-pair="105">
  <div class="tps-row">
    <div class="tps-steps"><span class="s-think">THINK</span><span class="s-pair">PAIR</span><span class="s-share">SHARE</span></div>
    <span class="tps-hint">click to start · 1:15 think, 1:45 pair</span>
    <span class="tps-clock" title="Click to pause or resume">1:15</span>
  </div>
  <div class="tps-bar"><div></div></div>

  <div class="tps-body b-think">
    <p class="tps-lead">On your own, write down:</p>
    <div class="tps-cards">
      <div><b>Knowns</b><small>given data, relations that apply</small></div>
      <div><b>Unknowns</b><small>what you are asked to find</small></div>
      <div><b>Questions</b><small>what is unclear or missing</small></div>
      <div><b>Hypotheses</b><small>your best guess, and why</small></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="tps-body b-pair">
    <p class="tps-lead">Discuss with your neighbors.</p>
    Compare your knowns and hypotheses, resolve your questions, and <b>settle on one answer</b> you can defend.
  </div>

  <div class="tps-body b-share">
    <p class="tps-lead">Share: who will tell us your group's answer?</p>
    <div class="tps-names">
      <div class="tps-name">?</div><div class="tps-name">?</div><div class="tps-name">?</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <span class="fragment tps-trigger" data-tps-step="start"></span>
  <span class="fragment tps-trigger" data-tps-step="draw"></span>
  <span class="fragment tps-trigger" data-tps-step="draw"></span>
  <span class="fragment tps-trigger" data-tps-step="draw"></span>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  if (window.__tpsLoaded) return;      // one controller serves every copy in the deck
  window.__tpsLoaded = true;

  var CHIME = true;                    // set false to silence the phase-change chime
  var called = [];                     // names already drawn in this lecture
  var audioCtx = null;

  function fmt(s) { s = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(s)); return Math.floor(s / 60) + ':' + ('0' + s % 60).slice(-2); }

  function chime(times) {
    if (!CHIME) return;
    try {
      audioCtx = audioCtx || new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
      for (var i = 0; i < times; i++) {
        var t0 = audioCtx.currentTime + i * 0.35;
        var o = audioCtx.createOscillator(), g = audioCtx.createGain();
        o.type = 'sine'; o.frequency.value = 880;
        g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.25, t0 + 0.02);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + 0.6);
        o.connect(g); g.connect(audioCtx.destination);
        o.start(t0); o.stop(t0 + 0.65);
      }
    } catch (err) { /* audio unavailable: stay silent */ }
  }

  function pickName() {
    var roster = window.TPS_ROSTER || [];
    if (!roster.length) return '—';
    var pool = roster.filter(function (n) { return called.indexOf(n) < 0; });
    if (!pool.length) { called = []; pool = roster.slice(); }
    var name = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
    called.push(name);
    return name;
  }

  /* ── One controller object per .tps panel ─────────────────── */
  function state(root) {
    if (root.__tps) return root.__tps;
    var st = {
      root: root,
      clock: root.querySelector('.tps-clock'),
      bar: root.querySelector('.tps-bar > div'),
      slots: root.querySelectorAll('.tps-name'),
      think: +root.dataset.think || 75,
      pair: +root.dataset.pair || 105,
      timer: null, remaining: 0, total: 0, last: 0, paused: false,
      drawn: []
    };
    st.clock.addEventListener('click', function () {
      if (!st.timer && !st.paused) return;
      st.paused = !st.paused;
      st.clock.classList.toggle('paused', st.paused);
      st.last = performance.now();
    });
    root.__tps = st;
    return st;
  }

  function setPhase(st, phase) { st.root.dataset.phase = phase; }

  function stopTimer(st) {
    if (st.timer) clearInterval(st.timer);
    st.timer = null; st.paused = false;
    st.clock.classList.remove('paused', 'urgent');
  }

  function runPhase(st, phase, seconds, next) {
    stopTimer(st);
    setPhase(st, phase);
    st.total = st.remaining = seconds;
    st.last = performance.now();
    var tick = function () {
      var now = performance.now();
      if (!st.paused) st.remaining -= (now - st.last) / 1000;
      st.last = now;
      st.clock.textContent = fmt(st.remaining);
      st.clock.classList.toggle('urgent', st.remaining <= 10);
      st.bar.style.transform = 'scaleX(' + Math.max(0, st.remaining / st.total) + ')';
      if (st.remaining <= 0) { stopTimer(st); next(); }
    };
    tick();
    st.timer = setInterval(tick, 200);
  }

  function start(st) {
    runPhase(st, 'think', st.think, function () {
      chime(1);
      runPhase(st, 'pair', st.pair, function () { chime(2); share(st); });
    });
  }

  function share(st) { stopTimer(st); setPhase(st, 'share'); }

  function draw(st, animate) {
    if (st.root.dataset.phase !== 'share') share(st);
    var slot = st.slots[st.drawn.length];
    if (!slot) return;
    var name = pickName();
    st.drawn.push(name);
    if (!animate) { slot.textContent = name; slot.className = 'tps-name landed'; return; }
    var roster = window.TPS_ROSTER || [name], k = 0;
    slot.className = 'tps-name rolling';
    slot.__spin = setInterval(function () {
      slot.textContent = roster[Math.floor(Math.random() * roster.length)];
      if (++k >= 14) {
        clearInterval(slot.__spin);
        slot.textContent = name;
        slot.className = 'tps-name landed';
      }
    }, 70);
  }

  function undraw(st) {
    var name = st.drawn.pop();
    if (name === undefined) return;
    var i = called.lastIndexOf(name);
    if (i >= 0) called.splice(i, 1);
    var slot = st.slots[st.drawn.length];
    clearInterval(slot.__spin);
    slot.textContent = '?'; slot.className = 'tps-name';
  }

  function reset(st) {
    stopTimer(st);
    while (st.drawn.length) undraw(st);
    st.clock.textContent = fmt(st.think);
    st.bar.style.transform = 'scaleX(1)';
    setPhase(st, 'idle');
  }

  function onFragment(e, shown) {
    var frags = e.fragments || (e.fragment ? [e.fragment] : []);
    frags.forEach(function (f) {
      if (!f.dataset || !f.dataset.tpsStep) return;
      var st = state(f.closest('.tps'));
      if (f.dataset.tpsStep === 'start') { shown ? start(st) : reset(st); }
      else { shown ? draw(st, true) : undraw(st); }
    });
  }

  /* Arriving backward from a later slide shows every fragment without
     replaying them: show SHARE with the names, but skip the timers. */
  function onSlide(e) {
    if (!e.currentSlide) return;
    e.currentSlide.querySelectorAll('.tps').forEach(function (root) {
      var st = state(root);
      var vis = root.querySelectorAll('.tps-trigger.visible').length;
      if (vis === 0) { if (root.dataset.phase !== 'idle') reset(st); return; }
      if (root.dataset.phase === 'idle') {
        share(st);
        for (var i = 1; i < vis; i++) draw(st, false);
      }
    });
  }

  function init() {
    if (typeof Reveal === 'undefined' || !Reveal.isReady || !Reveal.isReady()) {
      if (typeof Reveal !== 'undefined' && Reveal.on) { Reveal.on('ready', init); return; }
      setTimeout(init, 60); return;
    }
    if (init.done) return; init.done = true;
    Reveal.on('fragmentshown',  function (e) { onFragment(e, true); });
    Reveal.on('fragmenthidden', function (e) { onFragment(e, false); });
    Reveal.on('slidechanged', onSlide);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  else init();
}());
</script>
```
